folded.object: rye erokukorera abantu baayo kwimutsya omutindo gwamagara gaabo (Social Services)

spans.text: Buri muntu nayetaaga omutindo gwa magara ge, ogurkumubasisa kubaho kurungi aine amagara marungi namaka ge, arikutuunga ebyekurya ebijwaro, oburaaro, hamwe n'okujanjabibwa, kandi arikubaasa kweeyambisa ebi Gavumenti y'eihanga rye erokukorera abantu baayo kwimutsya omutindo gwamagara gaabo (Social Services).

folded.id: ebintu bye|omu|muringo gutari gwebiragiro
folded.subject: ebintu bye

spans.text: Tihariho muntu nowe oriihweho ebintu bye omu muringo gutari gwebiragiro.

folded.id: ebitarikubasa kunagiijurwa|omu|kukurakurana oku
folded.subject: ebitarikubasa kunagiijurwa

spans.text: Buri munyansi aine obushoborozi kutuura n'abantu bataahi be omu nisingye , eki kimbaasise kutereeza engyesho ze, nokuhika aha byaarikurubirira ebye kitiinisa nkomuntu arikuraba omu kukora kweihanga rye okurugiirira ahanteekateeka nenkozesa yobugaiga obweihanga omu byentasya, ebyemiturire ya bantu, nobuhangwa bwaabo, ebitarikubasa kunagiijurwa omu kukurakurana oku.

folded.id: ekyamahanga goona|bashemereire|kwijuka ekirangiriro eki hamwe nokufayo munonga obwo barikwegyesa no kugunjura abantu kutamu ekitiinisa amagara gobuntu omunsi yoona
folded.subject: ekyamahanga goona
folded.object: kwijuka ekirangiriro eki hamwe nokufayo munonga obwo barikwegyesa no kugunjura abantu kutamu ekitiinisa amagara gobuntu omunsi yoona

spans.text: Abantu boona ahu bari ahabwokugira ekyetengo kimwe ekyamahanga goona bashemereire kwijuka ekirangiriro eki hamwe nokufayo munonga obwo barikwegyesa no kugunjura abantu kutamu ekitiinisa amagara gobuntu omunsi yoona.

folded.id: emiteekatekyere y'abantu|kandi|okuhika ahabwire bw'abantu baraagirire obugabe bw'okugamba ekibarikwenda bakikiririza n'omu kibarikwenda bataine kibari kutiina nikyo abantu baburiijo bashemereire kurwanirira
folded.subject: emiteekatekyere y'abantu
folded.object: okuhika ahabwire bw'abantu baraagirire obugabe bw'okugamba ekibarikwenda bakikiririza n'omu kibarikwenda bataine kibari kutiina nikyo abantu baburiijo bashemereire kurwanirira

spans.text: Obutagyendera ahaabugabe bw'abantu burugiremi ebikorwa bibi ebisiisire emiteekatekyere y'abantu kandi okuhika ahabwire bw'abantu baraagirire obugabe bw'okugamba ekibarikwenda bakikiririza n'omu kibarikwenda bataine kibari kutiina nikyo abantu baburiijo bashemereire kurwanirira.

folded.id: enshonga ze|omu|mbuga zebiragiro ezihikire obugabe bwe bwaaba nibujogibwa
folded.subject: enshonga ze
folded.object: mbuga zebiragiro ezihikire obugabe bwe bwaaba nibujogibwa

spans.text: Buri muntu, naikirizibwa kutwaara enshonga ze omu mbuga zebiragiro ezihikire obugabe bwe bwaaba nibujogibwa.

folded.id: enteekateka ye|kandi|nokugamba narishi okuhandiika nkoku arikuteekateeka
folded.subject: enteekateka ye

spans.text: Buri muntu aine obugabe kugira enteekateka ye kandi nokugamba narishi okuhandiika nkoku arikuteekateeka.

folded.id: eyi arashome|kandi|aine obugabe we wenka narishi nabataahibe okuteeka omu nkora ebi arikwiikirizamu
folded.subject: eyi arashome
folded.object: aine obugabe we wenka narishi nabataahibe okuteeka omu nkora ebi arikwiikirizamu

spans.text: Buri muntu aine obugabe okwahura ekirungi aha kibi, nokurond ediini eyi arashome kandi aine obugabe we wenka narishi nabataahibe okuteeka omu nkora ebi arikwiikirizamu.

folded.id: eyi arikubaasa|omu|mbeera nungi nokuyambibwa omurimo kuri nigumuhwaho
folded.subject: eyi arikubaasa
folded.object: mbeera nungi nokuyambibwa omurimo kuri nigumuhwaho

spans.text: Buri muntu aine obugabe n'obushoborozi kukora naatekwa kwerondera ekika kyemirimo eyi arikubaasa omu mbeera nungi nokuyambibwa omurimo kuri nigumuhwaho.

folded.id: kungangarazibwa|omu|miringo gutari gw'obuntu
folded.subject: Kungangarazibwa

spans.text: Kungangarazibwa omu miringo gutari gw'obuntu.

folded.id: kureebererwa n'okuyambibwa|omu|muringo guhikire
folded.subject: kureebererwa n'okuyambibwa

spans.text: Abakyara abazaire hamwe nabaana nibateekwa kureebererwa n'okuyambibwa omu muringo guhikire.
Abaana boona oba abazaire baabo bagaitswire omubiragiro oba tibagaitsirwe mu biragiro nibateekwa kureebererwa omu muringo gumwe nka'bantu.

folded.id: kutwazibwa nk'omuntu|omu|mbuga zebiragiro
folded.subject: kutwazibwa nk'omuntu

spans.text: Buri muntu ashemereire kutwazibwa nk'omuntu omu mbuga zebiragiro.

folded.id: ky'amahanga ageeteraine|omu|kihaandiiko kyakyo nikihamiza kimwe kukirikwikiriza omu magara g'obuntu nomukitiinisa n'omuhendo gwomuntu kandi kimaririra okukora ekikirikubaasa kureebeka ngu omutindo gwamagara obushoborozi n'amagara g'omuntu nikihuru munonga omu kuhikiriza ekigyendererwa kyekihandiko eki
folded.subject: ky'Amahanga Ageeteraine
folded.object: kihaandiiko kyakyo nikihamiza kimwe kukirikwikiriza omu magara g'obuntu nomukitiinisa n'omuhendo gwomuntu kandi kimaririra okukora ekikirikubaasa kureebeka ngu omutindo gwamagara obushoborozi n'amagara g'omuntu nikihuru munonga omu kuhikiriza ekigyendererwa kyekihandiko eki

spans.text: Ekibiina ky'Amahanga Ageeteraine omu kihaandiiko kyakyo nikihamiza kimwe kukirikwikiriza omu magara g'obuntu nomukitiinisa n'omuhendo gwomuntu kandi kimaririra okukora ekikirikubaasa kureebeka ngu omutindo gwamagara obushoborozi n'amagara g'omuntu nikihuru munonga omu kuhikiriza ekigyendererwa kyekihandiko eki.

folded.id: na gavumenti|bashemereire|kukuuma omusingi ogu
folded.subject: na Gavumenti

spans.text: Eka nigwo musingi gobuhangwa hamwe neihanga nahabwekyo abantu na Gavumenti bashemereire kukuuma omusingi ogu.

folded.id: nahabwekyo abantu|bashemereire|kutuura kumwe nkabanya uganda
folded.subject: nahabwekyo abantu

spans.text: Abantu nibazaarwa baine obugabe nobushoborozi ebiri kwingana nibahangwa baine obwengye kandi barikubasa kwahura ekirungi nekibi, nahabwekyo abantu bashemereire kutuura kumwe nkabanya Uganda.

folded.id: nainga akahangahangusibwa|omu|muringo ogutarikugyendera aha biragiro
folded.subject: nainga akahangahangusibwa

spans.text: Tihariho muntu oraatsibwa atahozesibwe nainga akahangahangusibwa omu muringo ogutarikugyendera aha biragiro.

folded.id: nibainganisa obushoborozi|omu|bushwere bwabo bwagumaho nari bwahwaho
folded.subject: nibainganisa obushoborozi

spans.text: Omushaija n'omukazi nibainganisa obushoborozi omu bushwere bwabo bwagumaho nari bwahwaho.

folded.id: nkomuntu arikuraba|omu|kukora kweihanga rye okurugiirira ahanteekateeka nenkozesa yobugaiga obweihanga omu byentasya
folded.subject: nkomuntu arikuraba
folded.object: kukora kweihanga rye okurugiirira ahanteekateeka nenkozesa yobugaiga obweihanga omu byentasya

spans.text: Buri munyansi aine obushoborozi kutuura n'abantu bataahi be omu nisingye , eki kimbaasise kutereeza engyesho ze, nokuhika aha byaarikurubirira ebye kitiinisa nkomuntu arikuraba omu kukora kweihanga rye okurugiirira ahanteekateeka nenkozesa yobugaiga obweihanga omu byentasya, ebyemiturire ya bantu, nobuhangwa bwaabo, ebitarikubasa kunagiijurwa omu kukurakurana oku.

folded.id: ntandikirro y'oburinganiza|omu|nsi yoona
folded.subject: ntandikirro y'oburinganiza

spans.text: Ekitiinisa ky'omuntu ekyobuhangwa nikiingana nobushoborozi obutakabaasa kwihwaho eka yabantu boona heza niyo ntandikirro y'oburinganiza omu nsi yoona.

folded.id: obugabe bwokuza|omu|bitongore bya gavumenti kuhwera ensi yarimu
folded.subject: obugabe bwokuza
folded.object: bitongore bya Gavumenti kuhwera ensi yarimu

spans.text: Buri muntu aine obugabe bwokuza omu bitongore bya Gavumenti kuhwera ensi yarimu.

folded.id: obugabe kwiinikangira|omu|ihanga erindi
folded.subject: obugabe kwiinikangira

spans.text: Buri muntu orinkuhiganisibwa aine obugabe kwiinikangira omu ihanga erindi, n'okusheruramu obuhungiro hatariho kubonbonesibwa.

folded.id: oburi kugambwaho|omu|kihandiiko eki ahatari kushorora okwomuringo gwoona
folded.subject: oburi kugambwaho
folded.object: kihandiiko eki ahatari kushorora okwomuringo gwoona

spans.text: Buri muntu ashemereire atungye obusingye oburi kugambwaho omu kihandiiko eki ahatari kushorora okwomuringo gwoona.

folded.id: obwokwirukangara|omu|eihanga erindi
folded.subject: obwokwirukangara

spans.text: Obugabe obu, obwokwirukangara omu eihanga erindi, tibwokukozesa kubi kuri noogira ngu omuntu orikuhangahanguka, nateebwaho emishango etari yobutegyeki, narishi enshobi ezi arikukora tizirikugyendera ha bigyendererwa bya' Amahanga Ageeteraine.

folded.id: omnuntu yaahika|omu|muringo gwobuteeyamba kutunga sente eki kyaamubaho atakyetekatekire we wenka
folded.subject: omnuntu yaahika
folded.object: muringo gwobuteeyamba kutunga sente eki kyaamubaho atakyetekatekire we wenka

spans.text: Buri muntu ashemereire kuyambwa arekye kweerarikirira omurimo gwamuhwaho, narishi yaaremwa kweeyamba nainga omushaija yaferwa omukazi we, oba omufakazi, oba omnuntu yaahika omu muringo gwobuteeyamba kutunga sente eki kyaamubaho atakyetekatekire we wenka.

folded.id: oriihwaho obutuuzi|omu|eihanga rye narishi obutiikirizibwa kuhiinduraho
folded.subject: oriihwaho obutuuzi

spans.text: Tihariho muntu oriihwaho obutuuzi omu eihanga rye narishi obutiikirizibwa kuhiinduraho.

folded.id: orikukakwa kugyenda|omu|nkungaana nabandi
folded.subject: orikukakwa kugyenda

spans.text: Tihariho muntu nomwe orikukakwa kugyenda omu nkungaana nabandi.

folded.id: orubaju rumwe|kandi|nokumanyisibwa omushango gwoona ogurikuba nigumutabaarizibwa
folded.subject: orubaju rumwe

spans.text: Buri muntu ahatari kushoroora naatekwa kuhozesibwa "omu mushana" omu kooti etaine kugweera orubaju rumwe kandi nokumanyisibwa omushango gwoona ogurikuba nigumutabaarizibwa.

folded.id: orwanahanga ageeteraine|rurangirire|entuura y'obuntu aha bantu omunsi yoona
folded.subject: Orwanahanga Ageeteraine
folded.object: ENTUURA Y'OBUNTU AHA BANTU OMUNSI YOONA

spans.text: Nahabwekyo Orukiiko Orwanahanga Ageeteraine (General Assembly) rurangirire ENTUURA Y'OBUNTU AHA BANTU OMUNSI YOONA.
